# scripts/ops/Start-AvdRunRecorder.ps1

<!-- Generated by scripts/Update-BrainDocs.ps1 from the code. Do not edit; edit the code and regenerate. -->

Opens a recorded run: its run ID, run.json and the expected cost (cost.json), checked against the cap before anything is deployed (build/specs/run-recorder-spec.md sections 6, 9.3a and 13a).

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `-ParameterFile` | string | no | `'parameters/dev.bicepparam'` |  |
| `-Hours` | double | no | `3` |  |
| `-Cap` | double | no | `10` |  |
| `-DemoHostCount` | int | no | `1` | Session hosts the demo adds on top of the landing zone's own. |
| `-Location` | string | no | `$env:AVD_LOCATION` |  |
| `-RunId` | string | no | `$env:AVDLZ_RUN_ID` |  |
| `-Local` | switch | no |  |  |
| `-LocalRoot` | string | no | `$(if ($HOME) { $HOME } else { [Environment]::GetFolderPath('UserProfile') })` | Where the local copy of the run folder goes (default: your home, clouddrive when it is mounted). |
| `-SubscriptionId` | string | no |  |  |
